hero.title: N.S. Agricultural College
hero.summary: N.S. Agricultural College is an ANGRAU-affiliated college at Gobburu near Markapur. Established in 2016 by Sri NS Educational Society, it describes a 74.8-acre teaching farm across two locations. Its admission material outlines EAPCET and AGRICET routes for agriculture applicants.

overview.heading: Agriculture study near Markapur
paragraphs: N.S. Agricultural College was established by Sri NS Educational Society in 2016. Located at Gobburu, eight kilometres from Markapur according to the college, it is affiliated to Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University.

Its teaching farm is spread across the main campus and Thokapalli, with instructional units spanning crops, horticulture and crop protection. The four-year degree describes final-year rural experience, experiential learning and an agriculture-related internship. That practical structure is useful for students comparing field exposure: request the current unit allocations, village-work schedule and internship supervision arrangements alongside the entry-year admission notice.

admissions.heading: Planning an application to NSAC
admissions.intro: NSAC says university notifications lead the admission process and describes entrance-based counselling. Its site gives detailed but undated age, category and seat rules; these require the current university prospectus before use. For N.S. Agricultural College, the applicable ANGRAU counselling route now has a revised 30 October 2026 notice: registered candidates follow the stated November rank/category session and check the university’s live seat position. Being called does not guarantee admission.

campus.heading: Sixteen instructional units across two farm locations
campus.intro: The official farm page describes 74.8 acres: 43.9 at the main campus and 30.9 at Thokapalli. It lists 16 instructional units, including orchards, crop cafeterias, protected cultivation and a pest-and-disease-management module.

practical_learning: Department-maintained instructional units are described as supporting hands-on exposure.
The farm inventory includes agrometeorology and integrated pest-and-disease management.
The degree page describes fourth-year RAWEP, experiential learning and an internship with an agriculture-related enterprise.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: The admission FAQ states that eligible NSAC students may access the Andhra Pradesh fee-reimbursement scheme subject to prescribed criteria. No current scheme-year conditions, award amount or individual eligibility were verified.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: NSAC describes a placement cell that shares vacancies, invites campus interviews and circulates openings to alumni. The career page also mentions guidance lectures and webinars. These support activities are verified as institutional descriptions; no placement percentage or agriculture salary figure is claimed.
